sqlquery.from:
( select r.regdatetime, r.amount, r.accname, r.stype, r.product, coalesce(r.points, 1) points, r.qty qty from ( select tran.journaldate regdatetime, (invi.unitPrice * invi.qty) amount, 'Gross Sales' as accname, 'REVENUE' as stype, it.name product, icf.double_value1 points, invi.qty qty from "$".transaction tran join "$".invoicepayments invpay on tran.invoicepaymentid = invpay.id join "$".invoice inv on inv.id = invpay.invoiceid join "$".invoiceitem invi on invi.invoice_id = inv.id join "$".item it on it.id = invi.item_id left join "$".itemcustomfields icf on it.itemcustomfieldsid=icf.id where invpay.type='RECEIVABLE' and tran.deleted is not true and invpay.deleted is not true
union
select tran.journaldate regdatetime, invpay.amount amount, 'Merch.Payment' as accname, 'REVENUE' as stype, '' product, 1 points, 0 qty from "$".transaction tran join "$".invoicepayments invpay on tran.invoicepaymentid = invpay.id where invpay.type='PAYABLE' and tran.deleted is not true and invpay.deleted is not true
union
select tran.journaldate regdatetime, istock.quantity as amount, 'Pieces Sold' as accname, 'REVENUE' as stype, '' product, 1 points, 0 qty from "$".transaction tran join "$".item_stock istock on tran.id = istock.transactionid where istock.transaction_code='OUT' and tran.deleted is not true
union
select tran.journaldate regdatetime, eitem.subtotal, a.name as accname, 'DEBITS' as stype, '' product, 1 points, 0 qty from "$".transaction tran join "$".expenseReport ex on tran.expenseReportid = ex.id join "$".expense eitem on ex.id = eitem.reportId join "$".account a on eitem.accountId = a.id where tran.deleted is not true
union all
select x.regdatetime , x.debit, ac.name as accname, 'DEBITS' as stype, '' product, 1 points, 0 qty from (select max(tran.journaldate) regdatetime, sum(tItem.debit) debit,tItem.accountid from "$".transaction tran join "$".invoice inv on inv.id=tran.invoiceid join "$".transactionItem tItem on tran.id=tItem.transactionid where tran.deleted is not true and tItem.debit is not null and inv.type='RECEIVABLE' group by tran.id,tItem.accountid ) x join "$".account ac on ac.id=x.accountid where ac.key is null and x.debit > 0
) r
) t
